name: ALTRESEARCH -- equity research call transcript corpus, joined to Opal ETF weights, to rank alternative-data pipeline opportunities by firm-wide position materiality
description: Andrew-direct commission 2026-07-31 (CRO terminal). Two halves that meet at a join. (A) CORPUS: a structured store at research_transcripts/ for the equity research team's Teams call transcripts -- Andrew pastes each transcript and states its date, CRO structures it into bronze(verbatim)/silver(parsed)/index(mentions). Iterative until the back catalogue is exhausted. (B) MATERIALITY JOIN: collate the corpus for security names appearing in the four Opal ETFs (DIVZ, IDVZ, PFOE, PFDE), then produce a weighted aggregate per security ACROSS the four funds plus ranked weights WITHIN each fund, ordered from the largest position. PREMISE (Andrew, verbatim): 'the heavier the position is in the ETF and for the firm as a whole, those are the most material candidates for ALTRESEARCH alt data pipelines.' The corpus tells us what the research team spends attention on; the ETF weights tell us what the firm has capital behind; the intersection, ranked, is the build queue.

prds.label: Store contract: layout, bronze-is-raw discipline, the three-clock timestamp model, coverage semantics, ingest procedure, known limits

phase: *** PHASE 1 SUBSTANTIALLY LANDED 2026-07-31 -- CORPUS INGESTED (28 meetings) + MATERIALITY JOIN COMPLETE (4 of 4 ETFs) + BUILD QUEUE EMITTED. *** Andrew obtained the full back catalogue via a Lauren-shared /recordings folder and downloaded 30 .vtt files; 28 are UNIQUE (two byte-identical duplicate pairs, caught by md5 -- ingesting by filename would have double-counted two meetings). Landed byte-faithfully under research_transcripts/raw/ with a 30-row MANIFEST.tsv that drops nothing. 14,441 utterances / 250,844 chars / 4 speakers (Adam Muller, CONFERENCE ROOM, CONFERENCE ROOM 2, William Wicker). DATING: 6 of 28 dated (2026-07-13/17/21/23/27/31); 22 UNDATED in raw/_undated/ keyed by transcript GUID -- NOT guessed. CORRECTED 2026-07-31 after Andrew supplied the Teams recap card as ground truth: my first pass declared duration-matching REFUTED, and that verdict was WRONG -- caused by TWO of my own measurement bugs, not by the method. (i) I took the trailing 'Recording has been saved' notice as the meeting end; it posts ~9min later (07-31: ended 10:42, saved 10:51), inflating every duration and manufacturing a fake 'offset'. (ii) I then measured VTT length as last-minus-FIRST cue, discarding the opening silence, when the recording clock starts at zero so LAST-CUE is the length. With both fixed the key is excellent: 6 of 7 meetings match within 60s, most within 10s, and 07-31 reconstructs to 1h17m19s against the recap's 1h17m19s. THE FIXED INSTRUMENT THEN FOUND A REAL BREAK: index 6 misses 2026-07-10 by 12min (48m16s vs 1h00m15s) and no neighbour fits, so the 1:1 index-to-date chain holds only for indices 0-5. At least one July meeting appears to have produced no downloadable transcript. The 07-10 and 07-06 assignments were DEMOTED back to undated -- a wrongly-dated transcript is worse than an undated one. MATERIALITY JOIN (from 07-31 earlier): 4-ETF ranking complete on Andrew's TrueShares egress word -- 166 securities, $740,398,918 combined net assets, mixed vintage DISCLOSED (DIVZ/IDVZ 7/31, PFOE/PFDE 7/30, vintage_aligned=false). BUILD QUEUE: 44 of 166 securities discussed in >=1 meeting (26.5%); 10 of the top-20 firm positions appear. 1 REJECTED on context (CI = transcription fragment of MSCI), 1 LOW-confidence (UBS = research source, not a position), 7 ticker-only hits CONTEXT-VERIFIED with the quoted fragment recorded in the artifact. Top of queue: UNH 3.019%, MPLX 2.250%, NVDA 1.905%, UPS 1.776%; ASML is the most-discussed name (7 meetings, 20 mentions).
blocking: (1) DATES for the 22 undated transcripts (April -> 2026-07-10). The Teams meeting chat holds the occurrence timestamps, but the m365 gateway caps read_chat_messages at 50 messages with NO paging parameter, which reaches back only to 2026-07-06. Two fixes, either sufficient: Andrew supplies the meeting-date list, OR the gateway gains chat paging + `eventDetail` in its $select (eventDetail carries callDuration/callEndTime and would make dating EXACT rather than inferred). The gateway change is an infra change -> CTO arch-gate, not a direct-to-AE route. NOT blocking the build queue, which needs no dates. (2) NOT BLOCKING, owner-held: automated transcript ingest. The gateway can reach ONLY /me/drive and /sites/{id}/drive (source-confirmed, app/ms_ingest.py:12) -- it has no sharedWithMe, no /shares/{id}, and no tool accepting a user/drive id, so a folder shared into 'Shared with me' is STRUCTURALLY unreachable. Manual download is the working path.

hazards: COVERAGE: a pasted Teams transcript is frequently PARTIAL (transcript 1 = 3.7%). A gap is UNOBSERVED, not empty. Never compute share-of-attention or 'the team never discussed X' from a partial paste without stating the denominator.

TIMESTAMPS: three clocks. Line offsets are ELAPSED from RECORDING start (transcript 1 opens at 2:47, so recording start != meeting start); meeting start is OPERATOR-STATED in Eastern; derived_utc is COMPUTED, never observed. DST offset is passed explicitly, never inferred.
SPEAKER IDENTITY: 'CONFERENCE ROOM' is a room device and may aggregate several people. Speaker-attributed analysis must treat it as unresolved rather than as one analyst.

TWO QUANTITIES, NOT ONE: a weighted aggregate ACROSS funds and a ranked weight WITHIN a fund answer different questions. A name can be a top-5 position in one fund and immaterial firm-wide. Label the basis on every figure -- this is the 0824/0833 lesson in a new place.

DENOMINATOR OF THE AGGREGATE: 'weighted across the 4 ETFs' is ambiguous until the weighting basis is fixed. Weight-by-fund-net-assets (the firm-materiality reading, and the one the premise implies) differs from a simple mean of weight_pct. State the basis in the artifact.
BRONZE: raw/ is byte-faithful and never cleaned. A research call is a one-shot capture -- if the parser drops a line and the raw was tidied first, the content is gone permanently.

SENSITIVITY: internal research-call transcripts carrying non-public views on securities held in Opal funds, git-tracked in a private repo. Consistent with existing workspace practice for positions/client data, but a different content class -- surfaced to Andrew, his call.
